about: Candidate segments reconstructed from three i1Pro 2 ruler diagnostics files of one tester (public forum attachments, 2026-11-15) by scripts/make_margin_fixtures.py. Colours are the 3-band trace used as XYZ (relative to D50 white), not CIE colours. Candidate: [first reading, readings, signed ruler steps, band0, band1, band2, ruler position at the first reading]. ruler_sign: the sign of the recording's net travel; ruler_back: the most its position fell back against it.
